configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-x64
configurePresets.description: The officially supported, fully verifiable-on-Windows configuration. Open this folder directly in Visual Studio 2022 (File > Open > Folder) and VS will offer this preset automatically via its built-in CMake support, or run 'cmake --preset windows-msvc-x64' from a Developer Command Prompt.

configurePresets.name: linux-mingw-cross
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for Windows using MinGW-w64 (Linux dev sandbox)
configurePresets.description: Used to develop/verify the Win32-facing code from a non-Windows machine, as documented in docs/ENVIRONMENT.md. Not a substitute for the windows-msvc-x64 preset.

configurePresets.name: linux-native-tests
configurePresets.displayName: Native Linux build for portable unit tests only
configurePresets.description: Builds and runs the platform-independent components (Common, PowerResilience state machine, Configuration, Logging, Ipc codec) with GoogleTest. This is what actually ran in the sandbox that produced this repository. Does not build the Windows Service or GUI.
